chunks: "I guarantee for the one who practices moderation that he will not become poor."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.يَفْتَقِرَ: to become poor or fall into poverty

ai.seo_question: How does moderation in spending help prevent poverty in hadith teachings?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that moderation and balanced spending protect a person from falling into poverty. The hadith emphasizes ethical restraint and prudent conduct in worldly affairs as a means of financial stability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1721 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"I guarantee for the one who practices moderation that they will not face poverty."
